verdict.rationale: Factory offers droid exec for headless, one-shot automation in CI/CD pipelines and scripts, remote delegation via Linear/Jira issue assignment or @Factory mentions, automated code review/CI checks, and persistent Droid Computers/Missions that run structured multi-step work with tiered autonomy for unattended operation. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of these automations running unattended over time, and more detail on scheduling/triggering mechanisms beyond issue-assignment and CI hooks.
